name: Otonari no Musume ni Itazura
source:
The main character lives alone in an apartment.  One day, a single mother and her young daughter move in to the empty room next door.

By chance, he becomes friends with the cute, shy girl, and she spends time in the protagonist's room after school while her mother is still out.

Exhausted from P.E activities, the tired girl falls asleep while doing homework one day.

"With her dress in that position, I can see her underwear"

...so I reached for her while making sure she wouldn't wake up...
translation:
主角独自住在公寓里。一天，一位单亲妈妈带着年幼的女儿搬进隔壁空房。

机缘巧合之下，他和那个可爱又腼腆的女孩成了朋友。放学后，趁女孩的母亲还没回来，她会待在主角的房间里。

有一天，女孩上完体育课后疲惫不堪，做作业时睡着了。

“她的裙子这样掀着，内裤都看得见。”

……于是我确认她不会醒来后，便向她伸出了手……
